assessments.rationale: The integration guide affirmatively states the receiver processes any well-formed callback, that callbacks are not signed, and that the provider's signing feature is not enabled.
The incident review affirmatively confirmed the endpoint accepts unsigned requests from anywhere and that enabling signing is unscheduled backlog work.
The notes record safe retries during outages and nothing about repeated deliveries of the same callback; whether repetition is prevented or harmless is not established either way.
missing_evidence: whether re-processing a previously delivered callback is prevented or idempotent
